title: Understanding Print & Sentences
description: Explore letters, words, spaces, sentence beginnings and endings, and print order through five guided Kindergarten activities.
learningFocus: Recognize how letters form words and how spacing, capitals, punctuation, and word order organize sentences.
adultGuidance: Read the teaching examples together and have your child point to each word from left to right. When correcting a sentence, ask what belongs at the beginning, between words, and at the end.
